defs.def: beautiful; attractive 美丽的；优美的；有吸引力的；迷人的

ex.s: Skirting the town square, you’ll find lovely shops, eateries, and the Black and White House Museum.
ex.t: 绕过镇广场，你会看到可爱的商店、餐馆，以及黑白宅博物馆。

ex.s: If I asked what she had for lunch, she might say, “Oh, the weather has been lovely today. ” She seemed to recycle the same handful of answers to my questions.
ex.t: 如果我问她午饭吃了什么，她可能会说："哦，今天天气真好。"她似乎总在用同样那几个答案应付我的问题。

ex.s: You can also bike along lovely landscapes outside of Amsterdam.
ex.t: 你也可以在阿姆斯特丹以外美丽的风景中骑行。

ex.s: The bees, butterfly and many other insects looked lovely and beautifully on the stamps.
ex.t: 蜜蜂、蝴蝶和许多其他昆虫在邮票上看起来可爱又美丽。

ex.s: Our journey takes us to picturesque Berber villages and lovely beaches.
ex.t: 我们的旅程将带我们前往风景如画的柏柏尔村庄和美丽的海滩。

defs.def: very enjoyable and pleasant; wonderful 令人愉快的；极好的

ex.s: As I was looking at it, the lovely memory of that day came back to me.
ex.t: 当我看着它的时候，那天的美好回忆涌上心头。

ex.s: The more we know about this lovely creature, the greater the chance it will survive and keep its place in the natural world for a long time to come.
ex.t: 我们对这种可爱的生物了解得越多，它就越有可能生存下来，并在未来很长一段时间内保持其在自然界的地位。

ex.s: It's smooth and creamy with fresh strawberries, which give it a lovely sweet and fruity taste.
ex.t: 它光滑而奶油般的味道，搭配新鲜的草莓，使其具有可爱的甜味和果味。

ex.s: With both shallow and deep-water dive sites, there’s something for divers of all skill levels, from shipwrecks waiting for you to discover their secrets to the islands’ lovely baby seals!
ex.t: 拥有浅水潜点和深水潜点，各个技术水平的潜水员都能找到适合自己的，从等待你探索其秘密的沉船到岛上可爱的海豹宝宝！

ex.s: SENIC DIVING: Swim with Farne’s most lovely residents: the thousands of grey seals that live on the island all year.
ex.t: 风景潜水：与法恩群岛最可爱的居民一起游泳——那些全年生活在岛上的成千上万只灰海豹。

defs.def: very kind, generous and friendly 人

ex.s: These gentle, lovely gatekeepers welcomed her and kick-started what was to be a trip Ginni would never forget.
ex.t: 这些温柔可爱的守门人欢迎了她，开启了Ginni永远不会忘记的一段旅程。

ex.s: It is the story of an American travelling to a strange land, and of the people he meets on his way: Rustam, his translator, a lovely 24-year-old who picked up his colorful English in California, Oleg and Natasha, his hosts in Tashkent, and a string of foreign aid workers.
ex.t: 这是一位美国人旅行到一个陌生的地方的故事，还有他在路上遇到的人：鲁斯塔姆，他的翻译家，一个可爱的24岁少年，在加利福尼亚，奥列格和娜塔莎，他的东道主塔什干，以及一串外援工人。
